sources.title: Podcasts, episodes or audio URLs
sources.description: Podcast RSS feed URLs, Apple Podcasts show or episode links, episode web pages, or direct audio/video file URLs (mp3, m4a, mp4, wav...). Feeds return the newest episodes (see maxEpisodesPerFeed). Spotify and YouTube links are not supported. Example: ["https://feeds.buzzsprout.com/1.rss", "https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/id1584274529"]

maxEpisodesPerFeed.title: Max episodes per feed / show
maxEpisodesPerFeed.description: Newest N episodes taken from each feed or Apple show link. 0 = all episodes in the feed. Example: 5

transcriptMode.title: Transcript source
transcriptMode.description: auto: use the publisher's Podcasting 2.0 transcript ($0.01 per episode) and transcribe only when none exists (per audio minute). publisherOnly: never run speech-to-text. speechToText: always transcribe.

maxAudioMinutes.title: Max transcribed audio minutes per run
maxAudioMinutes.description: Hard cap on speech-to-text minutes billed in this run; episodes that would exceed it are skipped (not charged, retryable). 0 = publisher transcripts only. Combine with the run option maxTotalChargeUsd. Example: 300

maxMinutesPerEpisode.title: Max minutes per episode
maxMinutesPerEpisode.description: Episodes longer than this are skipped (not charged), or transcribed only up to this length when truncateLongEpisodes is on. Example: 240

truncateLongEpisodes.title: Transcribe the start of long episodes
truncateLongEpisodes.description: When an episode is longer than maxMinutesPerEpisode, transcribe and bill only its first maxMinutesPerEpisode minutes (record flagged truncated: true) instead of skipping it.

onlyNewEpisodes.title: Only new episodes (monitor mode)
onlyNewEpisodes.description: Remember delivered episodes and skip them on later runs (never charged twice). Use with a schedule to get each new episode once.

monitorId.title: Monitor ID
monitorId.description: Optional name for the onlyNewEpisodes memory, so several schedules can track the same feeds separately. Defaults to the list of sources. Example: "weekly-news-shows"

publishedAfter.title: Published after
publishedAfter.description: Only episodes published on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Example: "2026-10-01"

titleFilter.title: Episode title contains
titleFilter.description: Only episodes whose title contains this text (case-insensitive). Example: "interview"

language.title: Language
language.description: Optional ISO 639-1 code (en, es, de...). Picks the publisher transcript in that language and tells speech-to-text the spoken language. Empty = auto-detect (about 100 languages).

vocabulary.title: Names and terms (spelling hints)
vocabulary.description: Guest names, brands and jargon passed to speech-to-text so they are spelled right. The show and episode titles are always used. Example: ["Adam Curry", "Podcasting 2.0", "Fountain"]

outputFormats.title: Output formats
outputFormats.description: Fields to include per episode: text (paragraphs, speaker-labelled when known), segments (start/end seconds, speaker), llmText (fillers removed), srt, vtt, markdown (also combined in TRANSCRIPTS.md). Same price for any combination.

includeChapters.title: Include publisher chapters
includeChapters.description: Add the episode's Podcasting 2.0 chapters (start, title) when the feed publishes them. Free.
